newsitem.title: CHINA: LG Group to invest $5 bln in China.
newsitem.headline: LG Group to invest $5 bln in China.

text.p: South Korean chemical giant LG Group intends to invest more than $5.0 billion in its chemical business in China over the next 10 years, the Xinhua news agency quoted the company as saying on Thursday.

The investment would be concentrated in projects involving oil refining and petrochemicals, as well as farm, daily-use and fine chemicals and biological engineering, the agency quoted a company official as saying.
LG Group saw promising growth prospects for China's chemical industry, Xinhua quoted the official as saying at a chemicals conference in Beijing.
Xinhua said LG had started to develop its chemical business in China in 1994 and now had six joint ventures in the country, producing cosmetics, PVC, dyestuffs and sorbitol.
It gave no details of the projects LG planned to invest in or whether they would be aimed at supplying the domestic market or geared towards exports.
